summary: This directory provides a collection of interactive component stories for the form generation system. It serves as a visual documentation and testing suite to demonstrate various field types, validation scenarios, and state configurations within the shadcn-based UI implementation.
responsibilities: Define visual documentation for form components
Showcase diverse field variants and configurations
Simulate user interaction and validation states
Provide sandbox environments for testing component rendering
relationships: Component stories demonstrate the various field types supported by the form generator.
The AutoForm stories aggregate multiple field variants to illustrate full form layouts and validation behaviors.
Interactive stories provide a mechanism to test component state updates and user feedback loops.
designDecisions: Separation of visual specification from component implementation
Exhaustive coverage of component variations for visual regression
